testcase.name: the answering line takes the words that were inside the bracket
a line that is entirely bracketed is left as it is
a trailing bracket becomes the answering line
nesting splits at the outer bracket
a source that marked its own answer is not second-guessed
a bracket opening mid-word is not a second voice
a line-synced answer shares the line's stamp and its stated end
the line ends when the answer does, not when the lead does
a bracket with no words in it is not a second voice
a bracket in the middle of a line is left alone
